meta.homeDescription: Pokémon card catalog, Hong Kong shops, and a trade board.

footer.rights: Not affiliated with Pokémon, Nintendo, Creatures, or GAME FREAK. Card images belong to their owners.
footer.p2p: Trades are peer-to-peer. Collect Scheme does not take payment.

search.cardHint: Find one card by name, or by name plus number.
search.setHint: Find an expansion by its name or set code.

home.title: Collect Scheme
home.setsBody: Find an expansion by name or code, in English or Japanese.
home.encyclopediaBody: Find one card by name or number. Related cards and sets appear while you type.
home.shopsBody: Four published Hong Kong shops. Check hours before you leave.
home.tradeBody: Post a buy or a sell, then talk on the thread. No checkout.
home.auctionBody: There is no bidding and no escrow. The page is only a preview.
